notes.title: Player perks
notes.content:
[h1]Passive skills that you can develop in the gym, that is available in base:[/h1]

[h2]Feline Swiftness[/h2]
The character uses his dancing skills in combat, gaining a 5/10/15% chance to completely avoid melee damage.

[h2]Old-ways medicine[/h2]
Healing effects on characters are increased by 20%

[h2]Field bandage[/h2]
At the end of each turn, the character has an 5/10/15% chance to put on an improvised bandage that regenerates 10/20/30 health points and stops any possible bleeding.

[h2]Hot streak[/h2]
Each attack has an 10/15/20% chance that the next one using the same tool will be free and deal 30/50/70% more damage.

[h2]Iron lungs[/h2]
While running, character has an 10/15/20% chance that he will use only half of the energy needed.

[h2]Getting all that there is[/h2]
All positive effects are 10/30/45% stronger.

[h2]Sure step[/h2]
Enemy actions that cause to lose control of your character are 20/30/40% less effective.

[h2]Natural resistance[/h2]
All harmful effects are 20/30/40% weaker.

[h2]Not this time[/h2]
Damage that would defeat the character, heals him up to 20/40/60% of his health. Only works once per level.

[h2]Disturbing on request[/h2]
The character has a 15/25/35% chance to react on his opponent's turn, even with no energy left.

[h2]You shall not pass![/h2]
Your character's chances of reacting on your opponent's turn are increased by 30/50/70% (relative to the base value).

[h2]Opportunity strikes[/h2]
A character has an 5/10/15% chance of gaining an extra move out of queue. It can occur no more than once per turn.

[b]Update 0.5.1[/b][/h1]

• Lots of bug fixes, graphics and gameplay improvements.

[h2]
NEW FEATURES[/h2]
• A new type of missions has been introduced - the adventure mode. The player places his units on the "battlefield", where battles are played automatically.
• The new office system - time system has been introduced. Time is needed to perform activities during free time - they increase the player's statistics.
• New stats have been added for the player - Strength, Energy, Stamina and Persistence.
• A training room has been added that allows you to increase the player's stats.

• New economy system. (5 main materials).
• New workshop (It works faster and has more features, plus it looks better!).

• Added a new big machine. Scrapper.
• Added 7 new pests.
• Added the ability to buy pre-made traps in the shop.
